title: Property — historical Article 31 and Articles 31A–31C; Article 300A

content.overview: Article 31 as a Fundamental Right to property was omitted by the Forty-fourth Amendment. Property is now a constitutional legal right under Article 300A. Articles 31A, 31B and 31C remain important savings.
content.study: Do not plead Article 31 as current Part III law. For acquisition and agrarian reforms, check 31A–31C. Article 300A requires authority of law; it is not a Fundamental Right enforceable under Article 32 as Part III.

sections.heading: Repeal of Art 31 as FR
sections.body: Forty-fourth Amendment omitted Article 31 from Part III. Use Art 300A for current deprivation-of-property claims.
